Civil Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Special Part)

Статья 616. Contract of work and labour

1. Under a contract of work and labour one party undertakes to perform certain work at the request of the other party and to deliver the result to the customer within the agreed period.

2. The customer undertakes to accept the result of the work and to pay for it.

Статья 621. Price of work and payment procedure

1. The contract shall state the price of the work to be performed or the method of determining it.

2. Where the contract provides for prepayment, the customer shall pay the contractor the agreed advance amount.
